title: Onboarding telemetry contracts and pinned-release cadence for Verified Model Profiles
creator: Ava Chen
description: Define a repeatable contract and pipeline for ingesting performance telemetry during model onboarding, produce a curated 'Verified Model Profile' artifact and an operational cadence for pinning and rolling model versions. This ticket covers: 1) telemetry schema and golden traffic harness for reproducible latency/throughput/cost measurements, 2) pinning cadence (stable pin, soft pin, emergency unpin rules), 3) publishing metadata and signatures, and 4) operational runbooks for drift detection and profile refresh.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry schema v1 published (latency p50/p95/99, tail token latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, cost-per-token) and documented in Confluence
Golden traffic harness defined and implemented as a reproducible job (GitHub actions + infra recipe) that produces deterministic perf runs for a given model/version
Verified Profile artifact format agreed (signed JSON manifest + perf CSV + test harness output) and example artifacts exist for two onboarding models
Pinning cadence doc: stable pin (30d), soft pin (7d), emergency unpin flow with automated fallback to compatible variant implemented
Alerting thresholds for profile drift and cost regressions added to Console dashboard and SLO dashboard
Playbook for on-call and SEs describing rollback, canary rollout, and customer communication templates created

decisions_and_tradeoffs: Decision: Use signed JSON manifest + compressed CSV for detailed perf traces to keep artifacts human-readable and verifiable — pros: transparency and auditability; cons: larger artifact size compared to binary bundles.
Tradeoff: We will normalize throughput by vGPU and include raw GPU-metrics. This increases onboarding complexity but improves comparability across Dedicated and Private deployments.
Decision: Pin cadence defaults — stable pin 30 days then auto-evaluate; soft pin 7 days for fast-moving models. Rationale: balances stability for customers and agility for model updates.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Synthetic harness may not reflect customer workloads leading to false confidence. Mitigation: require a sampled production-like trace run during onboarding for high-impact models and tie verification to customer-specific eval sets where available.
Risk: Profile artifacts grow unbounded. Mitigation: retention policy (retain signed manifests indefinitely, keep raw harness traces for 90 days by default) and archive older traces to cold storage.
Risk: Unclear rollback/communication paths. Mitigation: include an automated rollback webhook and templated customer notification in the runbook.
